question: How do workers receive dispatched jobs?

options.label: Long-poll HTTP
options.consequence: Every worker runtime speaks it today; a dispatch costs one held connection per idle worker.
pros: Works through every proxy the fleet already has
cons: One held connection per idle worker
Dispatch latency floors at the poll timeout

options.label: WebSocket push
options.consequence: Sub-millisecond dispatch, and the broker now owns connection state for every worker.
cons: Connection state to reconcile on broker restart
